threat_event: Skimming script published on website event pages that embed the checkout form captures card data during on-sales (overlay or replacement of the payment frame)
threat_source: Cybercriminal web skimming group, through a compromised marketing agency tag manager account or a compromised third-party script source
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 unmanaged third-party scripts on pages that embed the checkout form; agency publish rights without MFA or second approval; no change or tamper detection
existing_controls: Vendor protects the code inside its frame; web application firewall on the website; quarterly ASV scans
treatment_plan: Script inventory with authorization and justification; remove non-essential scripts from pages that embed the form; tag manager on SSO with MFA and two-person publishing; payment page change and tamper detection with alerts to the MSSP
owner: Vice President of Marketing and Digital
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$8M (card brand assessments, PFI, notification, fraud costs; card brand sublimit $1M)

threat_event: Takeover of a local ticketing platform account followed by a patron data export and changes to checkout, pricing, or payout settings
threat_source: Cybercriminal (credential stuffing or phishing of agency staff)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 local accounts outside SSO with no MFA, 2 belonging to departed agency staff; 14 admins; ticketing audit log not reviewed
existing_controls: SSO and MFA for 175 employee accounts; role permissions
treatment_plan: Disable the 2 departed accounts; move local accounts to SSO or vendor app-based MFA; reduce admins to 6; alerts on new admins, setting changes, and bulk exports
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$4M (notification of up to 1.1 million patrons, counsel, forensics)

threat_event: Misuse of the full-admin ticketing API key held by the nightly sync function
threat_source: Cybercriminal or insider with access to the workloads account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key has full admin scope, sits in plain function settings, never rotated since 2024
existing_controls: Cloud access through SSO and MFA; guardrails
treatment_plan: Read-only key scoped to patron reports, stored in the secrets service, rotated yearly; alert on key use from new addresses

threat_event: Malware on a virtual terminal laptop captures card numbers keyed for phone, group, and premium orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 26 general-purpose laptops used for email and browsing key card data into the virtual terminal; corporate segment in the CDE
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 virtual terminal; SYS-09; SYS-08; BP-06
treatment_plan: Move phone, group, and premium payments to standalone validated P2PE devices that accept keyed entry, so no card number reaches a laptop

threat_event: Card numbers stored in CRM notes and mailbox attachments are exposed or misused
threat_source: Insider or cybercriminal with CRM or mailbox access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 312 card numbers in 141 CRM notes (9 with security codes) and 47 in mailbox attachments
treatment_plan: Purge all card data found; CRM field validation that blocks card numbers; email data loss prevention rule; card handling training for premium staff
owner: Director of Premium Seating and Group Sales

threat_event: 2026 ROC finds requirements Not in Place, the AOC is Non-Compliant, and the acquirer imposes conditions or fees on MID-T
threat_source: Structural: scope never documented; controls built for SAQ A
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No scope document; virtual terminal and website pages outside prior validation; 6.4.3, 11.6.1, 10.4.1 gaps
treatment_plan: Scope document and data-flow diagrams; scope reduction for the virtual terminal before fieldwork; close High P03 rows; evidence file per requirement
exposure_estimate_usd: $250,000-$1M (fees, remediation, possible processing conditions on $54 million of ticket revenue)

threat_event: Phishing with real-time session theft leads to takeover of an employee identity, then access to ticketing admin, email, and cloud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA (not phishing-resistant) for administrators; 6.2% phishing click rate
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; email sandboxing; quarterly phishing simulations
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant security keys for administrators; token theft detections in the SIEM; conditional access on device compliance for admin roles

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects an artist settlement or County PAC remittance payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment instructions for artists and promoters arrive by email; no callback rule for bank detail changes
existing_controls: Email filtering; MFA; Controller approves settlements
treatment_plan: Callback verification to a known number for any new or changed bank details; dual approval for payments over $50,000; training for finance and booking
exposure_estimate_usd: $100,000-$500,000 per event (Amphitheater headliner settlements reach about $500,000)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts corporate laptops, venue office systems, and cloud workloads (settlement, website, patron data platform)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing admin rights outside the cloud; corporate segment reaches physical security and production; restores untested
existing_controls: EDR with 24x7 MSSP; immutable backups in a separate account; MFA
treatment_plan: Segment corporate from physical security and production; extend privileged access management; quarterly restore tests; ransomware tabletop

threat_event: Exfiltration of the patron data platform (about 1.1 million records) for extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Query logs not in the SIEM; 2 users with export rights; no egress volume alerts
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; private network; MFA
treatment_plan: Query and egress logs to the SIEM with volume alerts; data minimization (drop phone numbers and order detail older than 3 years)

threat_event: Exploitation of an outdated CMS plug-in to change website content or inject a script
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 23 plug-ins out of date; no plug-in security testing
existing_controls: Web application firewall; monthly OS patching
treatment_plan: Patch plug-ins within 14 days for critical issues; remove unused plug-ins; plug-in inventory in STD-09
owner: Vice President of Marketing and Digital

threat_event: Web agency deploy access is used to push malicious code to the website
threat_source: Compromised or malicious agency staff (supply chain)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agency has deploy rights through the pipeline; no security terms in its contract
existing_controls: Pull request approval by the digital team
treatment_plan: Security terms and breach notice in the agency contract; agency access through SSO with MFA; second approval for production releases
owner: Vice President of Marketing and Digital

threat_event: Third-party tags collect patron data in ways the privacy notice does not disclose
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 scripts with no inventory; 2023 privacy notice says tags collect no payment information and omits several uses
treatment_plan: Script inventory with data collected by each; privacy notice rewrite; remove tags with no owner

threat_event: Advertised ticket prices on the website calendar and in marketing emails omit mandatory fees
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Calendar and email templates show base prices; no pre-publication check
treatment_plan: Total price in every calendar listing, email, social post, and advertisement; template change; pre-publication check by marketing
owner: Vice President of Marketing and Digital
exposure_estimate_usd: $500,000-$10M (FTC civil penalties per violation; consumer redress)

threat_event: Dynamic pricing raises accessible seating above other seats in the same section
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accessible price levels inside auto-apply; no parity check
treatment_plan: Remove accessible price levels from auto-apply; daily parity check; refund the difference to affected buyers

threat_event: Posted per-customer ticket limits are not enforced as stated, and linked accounts buy high-demand inventory for resale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Limit enforced per account only; linked accounts not checked
treatment_plan: Change limit wording to match enforcement or add linked-account checks; post-sale audit after each high-demand on-sale

threat_event: Bot challenges block legitimate patrons, including mobile network users and screen reader users, during high-demand on-sales
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No measurement of false positives; audio alternative switched off
existing_controls: Guest services can release blocked patrons
treatment_plan: Audio challenge alternative on; appeal route; block and challenge rates by access type after each protected on-sale

threat_event: Loss of ticketing or scanning during doors at the Music Hall or the Club with no written manual entry procedure
threat_source: Vendor outage, network failure, or cyberattack (non-adversarial event at the venue)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual entry procedure written and drilled only at the Amphitheater; offline manifest download not a checklist step at two venues
treatment_plan: Write and drill the manual entry procedure at the Music Hall and the Club; offline manifest download on every door checklist

threat_event: POS or network outage during a show stops food, beverage, and merchandise sales
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offline acceptance under the P2PE solution unconfirmed
existing_controls: Vendor-managed POS segment; dual ISP at 2 venues
treatment_plan: Confirm offline rules with the POS vendor; written fallback per venue; cellular failover for POS at the Club

threat_event: Internet loss at the Club on a show night
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ISP; cellular backup untested under show load
treatment_plan: Second ISP at the Club; load test of cellular backup

threat_event: Ticketing vendor outage longer than its 4-hour RTO during a high-demand on-sale or show day
threat_source: Vendor infrastructure failure or cyberattack on the vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ticketing provider; contract has no recovery commitments
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 recovery commitments (RTO 4 hours, RPO 15 minutes)
treatment_plan: Recovery and service credit terms at the 2027 renewal; on-sale rescheduling playbook; event-day outage runbook (P08)

threat_event: The settlement application or the patron data platform cannot be restored within its RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restores never tested
existing_controls: Daily immutable backups in a separate account
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests starting 2026-10-20; documented recovery runbooks

threat_event: Compromise or deletion of the backup account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: None significant: separate account and credentials, write-once retention
existing_controls: Write-once retention; separate credentials; cross-account role cannot delete
treatment_plan: Accepted: controls already strong; reviewed annually

threat_event: Box office or call center staff issue fraudulent comps, refunds, or ticket transfers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Refund rule above $500 only; no review of comp and transfer reports
treatment_plan: Weekly exception report (comps, refunds, transfers) reviewed by the Controller

threat_event: Call center staff are socially engineered into transferring tickets or changing account emails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Identity checks are informal
existing_controls: Order number and card last 4 checks
treatment_plan: Scripted verification; callback to the email on file for account changes

threat_event: Exploitation of an internet-facing SD-WAN edge or VPN vulnerability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge firmware patched by the managed service on its own schedule; no internal scans of edges
existing_controls: Weekly advisory review; MFA on VPN
treatment_plan: Known-exploited vulnerability patching within 72 hours in the SD-WAN contract; quarterly internal scans of edges

threat_event: Malware from a touring crew laptop spreads from the production segment to corporate systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Production segment reachable from corporate; production Wi-Fi uses a shared passphrase
treatment_plan: Block production-to-corporate traffic; rotate the production Wi-Fi passphrase per tour

threat_event: Compromise of CCTV or door access controllers from the corporate segment disables monitoring or opens staff doors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Physical security segment reachable from corporate; integrator remote tool without MFA
treatment_plan: Restrict the physical security segment to the integrator jump host and the security office; MFA on integrator remote access

threat_event: Default administrator credentials on the Music Hall crowd analytics server allow takeover of camera feeds and analytics (found in P07)
threat_source: Cybercriminal or insider on the corporate segment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator left the default administrator password on the crowd analytics server installed 2026-04; reachable from the corporate segment
treatment_plan: Change the password the same week (done 2026-08-14); check all integrator-installed devices for defaults; add default-credential checks to commissioning

threat_event: Crowd analytics misses a dangerous crowd density in an egress or lawn area
threat_source: Model error or camera coverage gap (non-adversarial)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No validation of alerts against supervisor counts; 2 venues only
existing_controls: Security supervisors and radio counts remain the primary control
treatment_plan: Validation against supervisor counts at 6 shows; alerts treated as advisory only (P10)

threat_event: The video management system's face-matching feature is switched on without a legal and privacy review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature available in the VMS; no change control for VMS features
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171 (biometric data as defined in 501.702); N71-R05 (45(a))
treatment_plan: Keep the feature off; any use requires a P10 High-tier assessment and counsel review; vendor contract amendment

threat_event: The guest service chatbot discloses order details to the wrong person or gives wrong refund or accessibility answers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot looks up orders by email and order number only; no testing of accessibility answers
treatment_plan: Verification step before order details; accessibility questions handed to staff; monthly answer testing (P10)
owner: Vice President of Marketing and Digital

threat_event: Marketing propensity scoring and generative copy use data or make price claims contrary to the privacy notice or the fee rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Features switched on without review
treatment_plan: Pre-publication check for total price; privacy notice update; no sensitive data in segments
owner: Vice President of Marketing and Digital

threat_event: An attack on the ticketing tenant, website, or virtual terminal goes undetected for weeks because the logs are not collected or reviewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ticketing audit log (90 days), tag manager and CMS changes, and partner portal activity not in the SIEM
existing_controls: SIEM for identity, cloud, firewall, and EDR
treatment_plan: Export ticketing audit log, tag manager history, CMS logs, and partner portal activity to the SIEM; use cases for new admins, bulk exports, script changes; 12-month retention
exposure_estimate_usd: Raises the cost of R-001 and R-002 by extending exposure windows

threat_event: Excess or stale access after transfers and departures
threat_source: Insider or attacker using stale access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual reviews; 6 of 25 transfers kept prior roles
existing_controls: Automated deprovisioning through the identity provider
treatment_plan: Quarterly access reviews; transfer workflow removes prior roles

threat_event: Takeover of a standing privileged account outside the cloud (identity provider, ticketing, CMS, network)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing admin rights; push MFA; privileged access management only in the cloud
treatment_plan: Privileged access management for all admin planes; separate admin accounts; security keys for admins

threat_event: A service provider's control failure or responsibility gap exposes card or patron data (no current AOC or responsibility matrix)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment partner AOC from 2024; no responsibility matrix; tag vendors never assessed
existing_controls: Ticketing vendor AOC and SOC 2 on file
treatment_plan: Provider list with PCI responsibilities; current AOCs; annual review program (P09)

threat_event: Integrator remote access is used to reach venue systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator's own remote tool with password-only sign-in; sessions not recorded
treatment_plan: Move integrator access to the privileged access broker with MFA and session recording

threat_event: A lost or stolen laptop or scanner exposes cached exports or scan manifests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some staff keep patron exports on laptops
treatment_plan: Exports only to approved storage with expiry; device recovery report monthly

threat_event: Denial of service against the website or virtual queue during an on-sale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: None significant: vendor and edge protections
existing_controls: Edge service and vendor queue absorb attacks
treatment_plan: Accepted: provider protections sufficient; reviewed after each major on-sale

threat_event: Tampering with or substitution of a P2PE device at a bar, stand, or box office
threat_source: Criminal skimming crew posing as staff or a contractor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inspections not recorded; device lists not reconciled
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-02 box office devices; BP-03; BP-04
existing_controls: Validated P2PE; bar leads trained at hire
treatment_plan: Pre-event inspection checklist; quarterly reconciliation with vendor lists; training for event-day leads

threat_event: A card compromise is handled late: the acquirer's 24-hour and Visa's 3-day clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 plan has no card compromise steps; finance unaware of the 24-hour term
treatment_plan: P08 runbooks; tabletop 2026-11-04; finance and marketing training on the clocks
exposure_estimate_usd: $100,000 per Visa non-compliance assessment, plus fees

threat_event: The company cannot deliver the SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2 reports the County PAC agreement requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 history; P09 readiness gaps
treatment_plan: Readiness remediation (P09); Type 1 as of 2027-06-30; Type 2 period from 2027-07-01

threat_event: Settlement errors for County PAC events cause misstated remittances to the county
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Settlement application has no reconciliation report for third-party venues yet
treatment_plan: Reconciliation report from ticketing to settlement to remittance; processing integrity controls (P09 PI1)

threat_event: Misconfigured object storage exposes exports or settlement files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block public access; exports expire after 30 days
treatment_plan: Keep guardrails; monthly posture review

threat_event: A rogue wireless access point is connected to the corporate segment at a venue
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No wireless scanning on the corporate segment at venues
existing_controls: Wi-Fi controller rogue detection at HQ
treatment_plan: Accepted until the virtual terminal scope reduction removes the corporate segment from the CDE; quarterly scans continue at HQ

threat_event: Unsupported operating systems on 4 VMS servers are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 VMS servers past vendor support
treatment_plan: Replace the servers in 2027; restrict network access until then

threat_event: Privacy requests from residents of states with privacy laws (for example Texas) are not handled because applicability is unresolved
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No consumer rights process; Texas applicability under counsel review
regulatory_driver: Tex. Bus. & Com. Code ch. 541 (applicability under review)
existing_controls: Unsubscribe and account deletion through the vendor
treatment_plan: Counsel decision on applicability; request intake process if it applies

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over patron accounts on the vendor platform and steals mobile tickets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Patron MFA optional on the vendor platform
existing_controls: Vendor bot defenses and login rate limits
treatment_plan: Ask the vendor to enable risk-based patron sign-in checks and transfer alerts; guest services playbook

threat_event: Lightning, storms, or power loss at the Amphitheater disrupt systems during a show
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Outdoor venue; generator covers life safety and stage, not all network closets
treatment_plan: Extend generator or battery coverage to network closets; weather hold procedure tied to P08

threat_event: A patron export is emailed to the wrong recipient or shared through an open link
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No data loss prevention for patron exports
treatment_plan: Email data loss prevention rule for patron exports; sharing links expire in 7 days

threat_event: Card-testing bots use the checkout to validate stolen cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor fraud screening only
treatment_plan: Rely on vendor fraud screening; monthly chargeback and authorization decline review
